completeness.why: The new getRangeScheduleAmount covers only the range arithmetic; forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and the preview each keep their own null/number/range dispatch even though the existing getScheduledAmount decides all three cases, so they are partial. The budget template is untouched (its halve-the-rounded-sum variant could have been an explicit rounding argument), so it is none; recorded as left out for the preserved inconsistency, though the diff gives no reason.

interface.why: A narrow range-only helper with no parameter for the template's rounding variant, added beside an existing getScheduledAmount that already handled missing/number/range, so the real variation is not expressed and two overlapping helpers now exist.

disguised_duplication.where: The per-site null/number/range ternaries in forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (x2) and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions are left in place unchanged rather than reshaped; the remaining duplication is visible, not disguised.
